claims.scope: Original internal compatibility population at 907934281c4422baba6ef6580bd4080663c87e9e. Regular Git inputs are a complete supplied superset, not a minimal observed IO census; gitlinks and nonregular entries are metadata-only exclusions. Whole-file inverse removes only15 snapshots/wrappers to recover committed original bytes. Recognizers/raw/args and dispatch stay exact; independent115-case literal events and Unicode/CRLF/repeated scalar intervals remain unchanged. Actual returned/constructor/argument references distinguish clones. The balanced input_slice scanner has empty args and no parser/trim callback; its separate compiler lowerer is unchanged. All existing call/anonymous/named/mark origins and quoted-boundary repairs recur. No runtime cursor movement, source projection, grammar, public schema, ScannerCore, CI/hook/storage/dependency or other-repository change. Entry/match producers, executable quoted/comment membership, replacement, other backends and broad audits remain separately owned. The existing mark-copy deletion-observation repair remains CONFORMANCE-SOURCE-READING.2.7-owned. Book examples are rendered teaching. Initial book corruption matched zero raw bytes across a line break, so review stopped without an acceptance report; complete initial producer/render/input capsule is retained and rechecked, mutation is corrected and final actual render is independently reviewed. The initial copied freeze selected already historical named claim and stopped without changing it; corrected mark freeze verifies exact committed inputs even though mutable fixture preparation preceded it. Initial source-regex corruption also changed zero bytes because its target missed the recursive named expr group; review stopped without publishing verification. The original reviewer is retained, exact zero-byte mutation and unique actual target are rechecked, and every final corruption must alter its input before rejection. Necessary host tools are read-only; project data stays on the repository volume and RGX/PGEN remain black boxes. Wrapper startup .7 owns establishment/liveness; recovery/purge stay prohibited and no lifecycle guarantee follows. Previous proof bytes/counts/adjudications remain exact; only prior durability becomes historical. Focused proof does not claim canonical CI; full-family/infrastructure/push boundaries require it.
